body.statement: Open-ended Question 7. Determine the limiting minimax power function when \(r^{1/4}\sqrt{\delta_{\mathrm{sq}}}\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\), and decide whether an exactly calibrated quadratic minimizer attains it among \(\Psi_{\alpha,r}\). If not, characterize the strict gain of a nonquadratic invariant test.
body.justification: Rate optimality does not decide whether quadratic compression loses a motif-specific power constant.
body.gap: No cited source derives the finite invariant composite testing experiment needed for exact procedural optimality.
body.consumer: The answer determines whether a platform should deploy a more complex motif-likelihood test.
